title: SharedStoreRecord
description: Schema for records stored in shared vaults (e.g. data/shared/assets/**/index.jsonl)

id.description: Unique record id, content hash (sha8), or slug

created_by_tool.description: ID of the tool that generated this record

source.description: Original file path, URL, or hash

license.description: License of the produced artifact / source

files.description: Dictionary of relative file paths associated with this record

metadata.description: Domain-specific attributes (e.g. dimensions, sample_rate, audio duration)
